highlights:
Rent NVIDIA L40S 48GB from $0.625/hr | Per-Minute | Clore.ai

...

The NVIDIA L40S is a datacenter card that made two unusual choices. It carries FP8 tensor cores without HBM, so 48 GB of GDDR6 with ECC sits behind 864 GB/s rather than the 1,935 an A100 80GB gets. And it keeps its ray-tracing hardware, which the H100 dropped, so it is the one card here that can render and serve. What it does not have is NVLink or MIG. Page facts come from the NVIDIA L40S datasheet and a marketplace snapshot of 21 September 2026.

...

## The single listing, and the contract.

One L40S server was on the per-minute marketplace on 21 September 2026 and it was busy. A single occupied listing sets no price level, so the only rates on this page are the contract ones, which do not depend on any host being free.

#### The only L40S listed on 21 September 2026 was already rented. What should you read into that?

...

A sample of one server cannot tell you a utilization rate, ... What it does tell you is practical. If you needed L40S capacity on that day, the per-minute marketplace would not have given it to you, and the bare-metal route with its eight-GPU minimum is the one that was actually available.
